answer: To halt a Sybil swarm, networks enforce cryptographic attestation chains where each identity binds historical execution traces. Zero-knowledge proofs verify these operational lineages without leaking private weights. Staking curves mandate an exponential capital exhaustion factor for duplicate entities, rendering spoofed coordination an economic fable. Attackers signing counterfeit histories discover their digital quill cannot sign away superlinear staking costs; their sable balance sheets bleed out rapidly.
